mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item (item_name, item_type, item_brand, item_price, item_stock, item_category, reg_time, update_time) VALUES (#{itemName}, #{dbType}, #{itemBrand}, #{itemPrice}, #{itemStock}, #{dbCategory}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO item_img (item_id, item_url, img_name, is_main, reg_time, update_time) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{url}, #{imgName}, #{isMain}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT item_id as itemId, item_name as itemName, item_stock as itemStock, item_category as itemCategory, reg_time as regTime FROM item ORDER BY item_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET item_name = #{itemName}, update_time = NOW() WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
